categories.main_business_segments: Houpu Clean Energy Group primarily operates in the clean energy equipment sector, focusing on the design, development, manufacturing, and integration of natural gas and hydrogen refueling equipment. The company also engages in core component manufacturing for clean energy and aerospace sectors, EPC services for natural gas and hydrogen energy projects, smart IoT platform development for energy management, and comprehensive after-sales services. Its business segments include specialized equipment manufacturing, engineering and design services, ship leasing, and aerospace parts manufacturing.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies in natural gas and hydrogen refueling systems, including high-pressure hydrogen refueling equipment and LNG containerized skid-mounted refueling units. It employs EPC project management for large-scale energy infrastructure and integrates AI-driven knowledge systems (AIGC) to enhance product value and operational efficiency. Manufacturing involves a mix of in-house production of core components and outsourced processing for non-standard parts, with a focus on modular design and smart manufacturing systems, including digital and automated production lines.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Houpu serves major domestic customers such as PetroChina, Sinopec, CNOOC, various gas groups, transportation groups, logistics companies, and port terminals. Internationally, it has projects in Europe, Africa, Southeast Asia, Central Asia, and the Americas. Key markets include natural gas vehicle refueling, hydrogen energy refueling, LNG ship refueling, and aerospace military equipment sectors. The company targets clean energy infrastructure operators, equipment contractors, and government-backed energy projects.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively across China, covering all 31 provincial-level regions. It also has a growing international presence with projects and collaborations in countries including France, Germany, the UK, Russia, Portugal, Egypt, the Netherlands, South Korea, and Malaysia. Its global strategy includes establishing international R&D and marketing systems to expand overseas markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: Houpu operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the clean energy supply chain. It manufactures core equipment and components, integrates complete refueling systems, and provides EPC services for energy infrastructure projects. The company also offers after-sales services and smart IoT management platforms, positioning itself as a comprehensive solution provider within the clean energy equipment ecosystem.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes technology leadership and innovation-driven growth, focusing on hydrogen energy full-industry chain solutions including production, storage, transportation, and refueling. Key R&D initiatives include PEM and alkaline water electrolysis hydrogen production, high-pressure hydrogen refueling technology, liquid hydrogen pumps, and methanol supply systems for ships. It integrates AI technologies to build dynamic knowledge graphs and smart IoT platforms, aiming to enhance product efficiency and expand into new energy markets globally.
categories.revenue_model: Houpu generates revenue mainly through direct sales of customized natural gas and hydrogen refueling equipment, EPC project contracts, and after-sales services. Its products are typically large-scale, non-standardized equipment requiring long production and installation cycles. The company also earns income from leasing and technical services, with a predominant direct sales model supported by strategic customer relationships and bidding processes.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: As a nationally recognized specialized and innovative 'Little Giant' enterprise, Houpu holds a leading position in China's clean energy equipment industry. It has broken international monopolies in key hydrogen refueling components and maintains competitive advantages in natural gas vehicle refueling and LNG ship refueling markets. The company is acknowledged as a pioneer in hydrogen technology and a core domestic supplier for hydrogen refueling stations, with strong government and industry endorsements.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Houpu reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 630 million, a 32.67% decrease year-over-year, and a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 82 million, reflecting a 17.38% decline. Total assets stood at RMB 2.23 billion with net assets of RMB 1.15 billion. Despite recent revenue declines due to strategic order adjustments and subsidiary restructuring, the company maintains a solid asset base and sufficient order backlog, with ongoing investments in R&D and infrastructure to support future growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Houpu differentiates itself through comprehensive clean energy equipment solutions covering the entire value chain from core component R&D to system integration and after-sales service. Its proprietary technologies in hydrogen refueling equipment break international monopolies, and its AI-driven knowledge platforms enhance operational efficiency and product value. The company offers modular, cost-effective, and high-efficiency solutions tailored to customer needs, supported by a nationwide service network and strong industry certifications, positioning it as a trusted leader in clean energy equipment.
